about.data: Massive-STEPS New York check-ins (Apache 2.0), venue names from Foursquare Open Source Places
about.split: held-out test: 300 people, none used to choose the model or its settings
about.model: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, fine-tuned on earlier choices, then preference-trained, with one confidence temperature fitted on design-phase people
about.ask_rule: asks the one yes/no category question with the most information, when the expected gain from asking is high
limitations: Tested on past New York check-ins from 2012-13 and 2017-18.
It does not see where you are, so two places of the same kind can look alike to it.
It needs a history. People with no history are always asked.
Errands, trips and visits to homes are hard to predict, so it asks more there.
